description: NEXTN target-verify steps (R requests x 4 tokens) of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next at TP 1, one middle launch (layers gdn, gdn, gdn, qsa). Derived from AgentX corpus statistics (semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126 rev 23f152f6, decode-step-weighted context: p10 52K, p25 108K, p50 220K, p75 426K; steps by context bucket: <=4K 4.4%, 4-64K 9.2%, 64-128K 17%, 128-256K 25.9%, above 256K 43.6%) and the model's serving configuration (R <= 8 requests, max_position_embeddings 262,144); not yet confirmed by a live capture. Contexts are clipped at the cap (262,140 + 4 verify positions); AgentX steps above the cap cannot use this model. Two compiled widths (R = 1, the interactive single request, 4 rows; R = 8, the largest compiled batch, 32 rows); request 0 has the case's context, the others draw theirs in [ctx / 2, ctx]. Small and boundary contexts are correctness-only.
